definitions.explanation: A beetle that produces light from its abdomen.

examples.english: I went to see fireflies in summer.

examples.japanese: {蛍|ほたる}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}っている→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{蛍|ほたる}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいた→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: Many fireflies were flying near the river.

notes:
{蛍|ほたる} refers to fireflies, a beloved symbol of early summer in Japan.

KANJI:
{蛍|ほたる} - firefly (insect radical 虫); on-reading けい

CULTURAL TRADITIONS:
- ⟦{蛍狩り|ほたるがり}→蛍狩り：27856_hotarugari⟧: firefly viewing (traditional summer activity)
- {蛍|ほたる}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧: 'Auld Lang Syne' (graduation song)

JAPANESE SPECIES:
- ⟦{源氏蛍|げんじぼたる}→源氏蛍：noentry⟧: Genji firefly (larger, brighter)
- ⟦{平家蛍|へいけぼたる}→平家蛍：noentry⟧: Heike firefly (smaller)

SYMBOLISM:
- Summer season
- Fleeting beauty (⟦はかなさ→はかない：07898_hakanai⟧)
- Nostalgia

VERBS:
{蛍|ほたる}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: fireflies glow/flash
